source_of_truth: Operator direction 2026-06-11 (worktree-isolation-v0 D012 split): own the enforcement half of worktree isolation — plan-mutating commands refuse from the wrong worktree unless explicitly overridden with durable evidence, and cleanup is health-gated, audit-first, explicit, and never force-deletes — built on v0's canonical binding_health predicate, with the COMPLETE guard/cleanup threat model pinned by the D003 design pass: corrupt registry fail-closed, canonical path comparison, swapped-repo defense, override evidence durability (refuse when evidence writes fail), audit-first removal ordering, gitignored content PRESERVED by default (blocks removal, reported), and the operator-local config policy (declare missing/divergent explicitly, opt-in allowlist copy, no symlinks in v1).
completion_test: Every plan-mutating entry point (lock, audit, close, disposition, orchestrate dispatch) refuses fail-closed on wrong worktree, corrupt registry, or any failed binding_health conjunct, naming the reason; an override with a reason proceeds ONLY after the override record and binding snapshot are durably written; `plan worktree remove` removes only a healthy binding whose worktree is clean AND free of gitignored content (ignored paths block removal and are reported), audit-entry-first, with no force path anywhere; plan close never auto-removes; all proven by fixture tests per conjunct and per entry point with zero live auditor calls. `plan worktree create` declares missing/divergent allowlisted operator-local config explicitly and copies it only on the opt-in flag, never via symlink.

user_journeys.name: wrong-worktree-guard
user_journeys.description: A session in the wrong checkout (or against a corrupt registry, or a swapped repository at the recorded path) tries a plan-mutating command and is refused with the failed conjunct; an explicit override durably records evidence then proceeds.

user_journeys.name: safe-cleanup
user_journeys.description: Operator removes a finished plan's worktree; unhealthy or unclean state refuses with reasons; eligible removal is audited before anything is deleted.

user_journeys.name: local-config-honesty
user_journeys.description: Creating a plan worktree surfaces operator-local config divergence explicitly: missing allowlisted files are declared at create time, already-present-but-different files are REPORTED by default (never silently resolved), an opt-in flag copies missing files, a copy that would overwrite divergent content is REFUSED, and no symlinks are created.
